title: Experts disagree on .paqad/locks/refresh-context.lock
context:
Chief architect: Not a real disagreement: both are adopted. The issue says 'if a refresh is already running, skip', which only works if the refresh process itself holds the lock for its whole run and releases it on exit. Because a refresh was measured running over 5 minutes, the lock must also be refreshed while it runs (or the run capped below the 10 minute stale window) so a second refresh cannot reclaim it. Pick this option to accept the pair.

Target: .paqad/locks/refresh-context.lock
- performance-analyst: the lock is held by the rag refresh-context process for its whole run and released when it exits, not only by context-refresh-trigger.mjs around the spawn, otherwise two refreshes still overlap
- performance-analyst: a refresh that runs longer than the 10 minute stale window lets a second refresh reclaim the lock; the refresh needs its own time limit below 10 minutes or a lock refresh while it runs
